map.依据《劳动合同法》第40条计算解除劳动合同经济补偿（N+1）: Computes N+1 severance for terminating a labor contract under Article 40 of the Labor Contract Law
map.📖 查看「N+1经济补偿金计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "N+1 Severance Calculator User Guide"
map.按劳动者在本单位工作年限，每满一年支付一个月工资；六个月以上不满一年按一年算；不: By years of service with the employer: one month's wage for each full year; six months or more but under a year counts as a year; under six months pays half a month's wage
map.《劳动合同法》第40条三种情形（医疗期满、不能胜任、客观情况重大变化），未提前3: For the three cases of Article 40 of the Labor Contract Law, that is the end of the medical period, incompetence and a major change of circumstances, one extra month's wage is paid where 30 days' written notice was not given
map.劳动者月工资高于当地社平工资3倍的，按3倍数额支付，年限最高不超过12年: Where the monthly wage exceeds three times the local average wage, payment is made at three times that amount and the years counted are limited to 12
map.劳动合同解除前12个月的平均工资，包括计时/计件工资、奖金、津贴、补贴等货币性收: The average wage over the 12 months before termination, including time or piece-rate wages, bonuses, allowances and other monetary income
map.用人单位无过失性辞退且未提前 30 日书面通知，测算 N+1 补偿总额。: Where an employer makes a no-fault dismissal without 30 days' written notice, work out the total N+1 compensation.
map.N 按工作年限（满半年不满 1 年按 1 年）确定，再加 1 个月代通知金。: N follows the years of service, with six months or more but under a year counting as one year, plus one month in lieu of notice.
map.高薪者基数按社平 3 倍封顶、年限最高 12 年。: For high earners the base is capped at three times the local average and the years at 12.
map.工作 8 年、月薪 1.5 万、未提前通知: 8 years of service, ¥15,000 a month, no advance notice
map.N = 8，经济补偿 = 15000 × 8 = 120,000 元；代通知金: N = 8, so compensation = 15000 × 8 = ¥120,000; payment in lieu of notice = ¥15,000; N+1 totals ¥135,000.
map.工作 20 年、月薪超社平 3 倍（基数封顶 3.5 万）：N 封顶 12，经济: 20 years of service with a wage above three times the local average, so the base is capped at ¥35,000: N is capped at 12, giving compensation = 35000 × 12 = ¥420,000, plus ¥35,000 in lieu of notice = ¥455,000.
map.N+1 对应合法无过失辞退且未提前通知；2N 对应违法解除。性质不同，不能叠加。: N+1 is for a lawful no-fault dismissal without notice, while 2N is for unlawful termination. They differ in nature and cannot be combined.
map.代通知金按什么工资算？: What wage is the payment in lieu of notice based on?
map.按劳动者上一个月的工资标准；若上一个月工资不能反映正常水平，可参照解除前十二个月: The wage of the last month; if that does not reflect the normal level, the average over the twelve months before termination may be used.
